Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a flawed classification heuristic that conflated covering “sensational topics” with having a “tabloid-style” tone and also treated tabloid page size as equally determinative of style. This misapplies the definition of tabloid-style (which primarily concerns tone and presentation, not merely subject matter) and ignores that The Progressive Populist is a tabloid-format newspaper, not a magazine. This misframing would lead to incorrectly labeling Skeptical Inquirer as tabloid-style and failing to correctly address the publication type, setting the task on a path toward a wrong conclusion.
